Package lu.kbra.modelizer_next.ui.canvas.datastruct

package lu.kbra.modelizer_next.ui.canvas.datastruct
Transient canvas data carriers. These records describe selection state, clipboard snapshots, drag state, hit-test results, link geometry, and live edit state.
